verdict.rationale: The pricing docs say Sandbox usage is metered across several dimensions [42]. They also describe ways to limit billed runtime: a configurable timeout with a 5-minute default, the ability to stop sandboxes, and Spend Management alerts or pauses [37, 21, 24]. Nothing states the billing granularity, so pay-as-you-go metering is evidenced but per-second billing for only the compute actually used is not. Missing for 10: explicit per-second billing granularity, evidence that only active compute (not idle or wall-clock time) is charged, published rates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
